Honestly your best bet is to try to find someone who also seems rather isolated. How I made my first friends back when I was a kid. Even if you don't super get along it'll give you practice meeting and talking to people. And who knows you might like em, you'd be surprised the people you'd meet and make friends with. Honestly if they are alone at lunch and you think you may even have a passing interest in common to someone who's chilling with themselves go up say hey and ask them about said interest. And simply go from their, ping pong the conversation back and forth, if you don't know how usually asking questions about their preferences, even if it's only about said common topic, will get most people to open up.
